{{Top|leg}}
'''The Concourse''' was the centerpiece of [[Darknon Station]]. In its heyday, the Concourse was a multi-level structure that was filled with stores and services aimed towards visiting [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]]. The main level was the site of a large garden. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Concourse had fallen into disrepair. Many levels of the Concourse had been shut down and cannibalized for spare parts, with some sections open to [[Realspace/Legends|space]].

Visitors to [[Darknon Station]] could use the Concourse to access the [[Trade House]], [[Chapter House]], [[Stormview Lounge]], [[Van Serai Hotel]], [[Galaxy Shop]], and the [[Darknon Station Repair Bay]].
